```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r load-data}
recs2020 <- read_csv("recs2020_public_v7.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
anes2020 <- read_csv("anes_timeseries_2020_csv_20220210.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r clean-recs}
recs_indiv <- recs2020 %>%
  select(REGIONC, MONEYPY, TOTALDOL, TOTALBTU, SCALEB, TOTSQFT_EN) %>%
  mutate(
    region =  case_when(
      REGIONC == "NORTHEAST" ~ "NORTHEAST",
      REGIONC == "MIDWEST"   ~ "MIDWEST",
      REGIONC == "SOUTH"     ~ "SOUTH",
      REGIONC == "WEST"      ~ "WEST"
      ),
    income_group = case_when(
      MONEYPY <= 3  ~ "Low Income",
      MONEYPY <= 6  ~ "Middle Income",
      TRUE          ~ "High Income"
    ),
    energy_burden = TOTALDOL / TOTALBTU * 1000
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(region), !is.na(income_group), TOTALBTU > 0)
```

```{r}
anes_indiv <- anes2020 %>%
  select(region_code = V203003, climate_policy = V202350x, income_cat = V202468x) %>%
  mutate(
    region = toupper(case_when(
      region_code == 1 ~ "Northeast",
      region_code == 2 ~ "Midwest",
      region_code == 3 ~ "South",
      region_code == 4 ~ "West")),
   
    climate_support = ifelse(climate_policy %in% 1:7, 8 - climate_policy, NA_real_),
    income_group = case_when(
      income_cat <= 7  ~ "Low Income",
      income_cat <= 14 ~ "Middle Income",
      income_cat <= 22 ~ "High Income") ) %>%
  
  filter(!is.na(region), !is.na(climate_support), !is.na(income_group))

anes_grouped <- anes_individual %>%
  group_by(region, income_group) %>%
  summarize(avg_climate_support = mean(climate_support, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}

anes_rsummary <- anes_indiv %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(avg_support = mean(climate_support, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(region = str_to_title(region))

recs_rsummary <- recs_indiv %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarize(avg_burden = weighted.mean(energy_burden, w = SCALEB, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(region = str_to_title(region))

anes_isummary <- anes_indiv %>%
  group_by(income_group) %>%
  summarize(avg_support = mean(climate_support, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(income_group = factor(income_group, levels = c("Low Income", "Middle Income", "High Income")))


```

```{r}

indiv_data <- recs_indiv %>%
  inner_join(anes_grouped, by = c("region", "income_group"))

model <- lm(avg_climate_support ~ energy_burden + income_group, data = indiv_data)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
fig1 <- ggplot(anes_rsummary,
               aes(x = reorder(region, avg_support), y = avg_support, fill = avg_support)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_support, 2)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FF9999", high = "forestgreen") + 
  labs(title = "Climate Policy Support by Region",
       subtitle = "7-point scale (higher = more supportive)",
       y = "Support Score (1–7)", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

fig2 <- ggplot(recs_rsummary,
               aes(x = reorder(region, avg_burden), y = avg_burden, fill = avg_burden)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_burden, 1)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FF9999", high = "forestgreen") +
  labs(title = "Energy Burden by Region",
       subtitle = "average cost per million BTU",
       y = "$ per Million BTU", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

fig3 <- ggplot(anes_isummary,
               aes(x = income_group, y = avg_support, color = avg_support)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = income_group, y = 5.5, yend = avg_support), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_support, 2)), vjust = -1.5, color = "black", size = 3.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(5.5, 6.0)) +  
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#FF9999", high = "forestgreen") +
  labs(title = "Support by Income Group",
       subtitle = "Are not that noticable across income groups",
       y = "Support Score (1–7)", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

fig4 <- ggplot(indiv_data %>% 
                 group_by(region, income_group) %>% 
                 summarize(avg_energy_burden = mean(energy_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
                           avg_climate_support = mean(avg_climate_support),
                           .groups = "drop"),
               aes(x = avg_energy_burden, y = avg_climate_support)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = income_group), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low Income"    = "#FF9999",
                                "Middle Income" = "#B2AD7F",
                                "High Income"   = "forestgreen"  
                                )) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Higher Energy Burden = Greater Climate Support",
    subtitle = "12 region multiple by income group averages",
    x = "Energy Burden $/Million BTU",
    y = "Climate Support Score 1–7",
    color = "Income Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined <- (fig1 + fig2) / (fig3 + fig4)
ggsave("final_analysis_plot.png", combined, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 150)
combined
```
